name: Chuanbota Agent Coordination
description: Delegate tasks to authorized agents and track progress and verified results through an A2A Relay.
description_zh: 连接已授权的 Agent，发送任务、跟踪进度、查询结果，并处理用户明确选择的审批和取消操作。
description_en: Delegate tasks to authorized agents and track progress and verified results through an A2A Relay.
examples_zh: 查看我可以调用哪些 Agent
让指定 Agent 完成任务并返回验证结果
查询刚才任务的进度，不要重复提交
examples_en: List agents I am allowed to call
Delegate a task and return its verified result
Check the original task without sending it again
